en.title: Solar Cells Comparison
en.summary: Lab study comparing PV cell performance with structured reporting.
en.challenge: Photovoltaic cells and module configurations respond differently to irradiance, mismatch, and bypass behavior, requiring controlled measurement and comparable analysis.
contribution: Planned and performed photovoltaic I-V measurement comparisons.
Analyzed cell/module behavior and bypass-diode effects with Python.
Produced a structured technical report with figures and experimental interpretation.
technical: The laboratory setup captures voltage/current pairs under controlled conditions.
Python calculates key PV indicators and overlays comparable I-V curves.
LaTeX integrates methods, results, plots, and discussion into a reproducible report.

architecture.label: Experiment
architecture.detail: PV device, illumination, load sweep, sensors, and bypass configuration define each run.

architecture.label: Acquisition
architecture.detail: Voltage/current samples record the device response across the operating range.

architecture.label: Analysis
architecture.detail: Python derives characteristic points and compares I-V curve behavior.

architecture.label: Report
architecture.detail: LaTeX combines method, evidence, limitations, and engineering conclusions.

outcomes: Connected renewable-energy theory with controlled physical measurement.
Created comparable visual evidence for cell, module, and bypass behavior.
Demonstrated laboratory practice, scripting, and technical communication.

zh.title: 太陽能電池比較
zh.summary: 比較太陽能電池效能的實驗與報告。
zh.challenge: 光電池與模組配置對照度、不匹配及旁路行為的反應不同，因此需要受控量測與可比較分析。
contribution: 規劃並執行太陽光電 I-V 量測比較。
使用 Python 分析電池與模組行為及旁路二極體效應。
製作包含圖表與實驗解讀的結構化技術報告。
technical: 實驗設備在受控條件下擷取電壓與電流資料點。
Python 計算關鍵光電指標，並疊加可比較的 I-V 曲線。
LaTeX 將方法、結果、圖表與討論整合成可重現報告。

architecture.label: 實驗
architecture.detail: 光電元件、光源、負載掃描、感測器與旁路配置定義每次測試。

architecture.label: 資料擷取
architecture.detail: 電壓與電流取樣記錄元件在完整操作範圍內的響應。

architecture.label: 分析
architecture.detail: Python 推導特徵點，並比較 I-V 曲線行為。

architecture.label: 報告
architecture.detail: LaTeX 整合方法、證據、限制與工程結論。

outcomes: 將再生能源理論與受控實體量測連結。
為電池、模組與旁路行為建立可比較的視覺證據。
展現實驗室操作、程式分析與技術溝通能力。
